# The Production Possibility Curve

<!-- STEP id="curve" -->
Here is the farmer's table as five points, A to E. Barley is along the bottom; wheat is up the side.

<!-- STEP id="inside" -->
Join the points and you get a curve. Every point on it uses all the plot's land, water and labour.

<!-- STEP id="beyond" -->
50 kg of barley with 50 kg of wheat lies inside the curve: possible, but some land or labour stays idle. 75 kg of barley with 60 kg of wheat lies outside: this plot cannot grow it.

**This curve is the Production Possibility Curve (PPC): every combination of two goods that the resources can produce when fully used.**
